sentences.text:
Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
12.11.2024 rc/ct.no.34 Item No.147 Crr No.2827 of 2024 In the matter of : Alok Kumar Dwivedi
.......Petitioner Mr. Manjit Singh Mr. Biswajit Mal Mr. Soujanyo Pattanyak ...for the Petitioner

The private opposite party lodged FIR against the petitioner for offence under Sections 376/417/313/506/509/34 of the Indian Penal Code which was registered as ACGR Case No. 381 of 2022 and is pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the relationship between the parties is consensual and the private opposite party being a major was well aware of the consequences of her act all throughout.
The petitioner seeks quashing of the proceedings.
It appears from the material on record that the matter needs to be heard on merits.
The petitioner is directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of February,2025.

Further proceedings of ACGR Case No. 381 of 2022 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas be stayed till February 28, 2025 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Suvra Ghosh,J)
